name: phd-grade-below-c-excluded-from-credit
description: Grad School Academic Code §4.3 (DGS decision 2026-09-12): a passed grade below C does not count toward any credit-hour requirement, even though it still satisfies §4.4.1 core knowledge (which asks only whether the course was passed). CSE 60641, C-, still satisfies the Operating Systems core-knowledge row but contributes none of its 3 credits to the 24 regular-course credits.

CSE 60641: a passed grade below C does not count toward any credit-hour requirement
